<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 121.0528 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈120.0455 Da. The formula that matches this mass most closely is C₄H₈O₄ (calculated monoisotopic mass 120.0423 Da, within typical experimental tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula is C4H8O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
